## Share single songs
- **Share any song:** every song now has **Share** in its ⋯ menu, also songs from Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud and Deezer (before only songs on your own server could be shared)
- **Share button in the big player:** next to the heart, on the phone and in the full screen player on the computer, in every theme
- **Like Spotify:** on a computer the link is copied right away, on the phone the share sheet opens
- **Song page:** the link opens a page that plays the song for anyone, without app or account. Platform songs play through your server like in the app
- **Add to Liked Songs:** signed in, the song page adds the song to your Liked songs instead of making a one-song playlist
- **Previews:** Discord, WhatsApp and other chat apps show title, artist and cover of the song
- Sharing the same song twice gives the same link

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
